observations: Three photos show a large flat-screen TV displaying football match content.
The screen is turned on in all photos, showing vibrant images with good color and detail.
Photo 0 shows a close-up of players on the field; text overlay 'QLED 8K' is visible in the top right corner.
Photo 1 shows a wider view of the pitch; logos for 'mediacorp', 'Sport Singapore', and 'Singapore Sports' are visible on the screen.
Photo 2 shows a stadium view with a large crowd; watermark 'PRIME VIEW ELECTRONICS HUB' is visible across the screen.
The TV has a thin black bezel and is mounted or placed against a wooden or brown surface.
No physical branding or model number is visible on the TV frame or stand in any photo.
The screen content appears to be a live or recorded sports broadcast, not a demo or test pattern.

claims.evidence: Brand 'Samsung' is claimed by seller but not visible in any photo. Screen size is not verifiable from photos alone. No model number visible.
Text 'QLED 8K' appears in photo 0, but it is part of the screen content (a football match broadcast), not a label on the TV itself. Could be a watermark or overlay from the source video.
No interface, apps, or smart features shown. Cannot verify smart functionality from photos alone.

risks.risk: TV is not actually 43 inches or not a Samsung
risks.proof: Photo showing the TV with a known object for scale (e.g., a ruler, a standard-sized box) or a clear shot of the model label on the back or frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 43-inch TV, not as a Samsung or premium model.

risks.risk: QLED 8K claim is false — the TV may be a lower resolution or non-QLED model
risks.proof: Photo of the TV's back or front bezel showing the model number, or a screenshot of the TV's settings menu showing resolution and panel type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard HD or Full HD TV, not as 8K or QLED.

risks.risk: TV is not working or has screen issues (dead pixels, burn-in, backlight bleed)
risks.proof: Photo of the TV displaying a solid white or black screen, or a test pattern showing uniformity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially defective or with unknown screen condition.

risks.risk: Smart TV functionality does not work (no internet, no apps, no voice control)
risks.proof: Screenshot or photo of the TV's home screen or app menu showing available smart features.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-smart TV or with unknown smart capabilities.

proof_requests: Photo of the TV's back or front bezel showing the model number or brand label.
Photo of the TV displaying a solid white or black screen to check for dead pixels or uniformity.
Screenshot or photo of the TV's settings menu showing resolution, panel type, and smart features.
Photo of the TV with a known object for size reference (e.g., a 30cm ruler or a standard box).
response.reason: The seller claims a Samsung 43-inch QLED 8K Smart TV, but none of the photos show the brand, model, or size on the TV itself. The 'QLED 8K' text is part of the screen content, not the TV's label. Without proof of brand, model, size, and functionality, the item cannot be accurately priced. The risks include misrepresentation of brand, resolution, and smart features.
